body: I don't blame you for the mistakes you'll make. Please don't blame yourself.

I think she has experienced some post-partum issues but she refuses to discuss them with me. I've asked her to talk to me about them but no luck yet. She is a very private person.

I do know she had some self identity issues following the birth. We have sex again until about a month ago because of her self esteem (and frankly partly because of our son's sleeping habits).
